messages:
Mia Chen: heads-up — README embed sample's curl snippet on Windows has CRLF issues and missing Authorization Bearer example. Also JS sample uses 'engine' while Python uses 'model' for embeddings; copy/paste will break onboarding.

Jordan Patel: oof. where? link pls

Mia Chen: ./docs/quickstarts/embeddings.md — snippet block near 'curl -X POST'

Samir Khan: that's the SDK parity bug i saw. JS client accepts engine for legacy but new API expects model. We should update samples to use 'model' everywhere. Also add retry header example and note Windows cmd quoting. PTAL @Jordan

Jordan Patel: i'll open a small PR to change param name + add Windows note. will also add a tiny retry snippet with HTTP 429 backoff. ETA today :thumbsup:

docs-bot: Reminder: please follow docs styleguide for code fences and include 'curl --http1.1' for Windows where needed.

Mia Chen: example curl I suggest:
```
curl --http1.1 -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":"hello world"}'
```
Also a note about double quotes in Windows cmd: use ^" or use Powershell single quotes.

Jordan Patel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 — changed engine->model, added Windows curl note, added minimal retry pseudo-code.

Samir Khan: nice. can we also bump JS sample to use new client.import and show async/await error handling for 429?

Mia Chen: yes add snippet like:
```
try {
  const res = await client.embeddings.create({model:'embed-small', input:'hi'})
} catch (err) {
  if (err.status === 429) await backoffAndRetry()
}
```

DevEx Bot: linked PR merged into staging by Jordan Patel — ci passed :white_check_mark:

Jordan Patel: merging to main after smoke test tomorrow morning.
